⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. 🍠 High-Protein Sweet Potato Chicken Bowl (Serves 2) Healthy never has to be boring! This high-protein sweet potato bowl is packed with juicy chicken, roasted sweet potatoes, and roasted broccoli.    Ingredients: • 1 large sweet potato • 2 boneless, skinless chicken thighs • 2 cups broccoli florets • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp smoked paprika • 1 tsp onion powder • ½ tsp cayenne pepper • ½ tsp chili powder • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper   Directions: 1️⃣ Roast the Sweet Potatoes   Season sweet potatoes with salt and pepper. Roast at 425°F for 25–30 minutes, flipping halfway, until caramelized and tender. 2️⃣ Cook the Chicken   Season chicken with garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, chili powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper. Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. Recipe Name Honey Garlic Chicken with Creamy Parmesan Penne Ingredients 1. 2 large chicken breasts, sliced 2. 12 oz (340 g) penne pasta 3. 2 tbsp olive oil 4. 2 tbsp butter 5. 4 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 8. 1 tsp salt 9. 1/2 tsp black pepper 10. 1 cup heavy cream 11. 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1/2 cup chicken broth 13. 1 tbsp honey 14. 1 tbsp soy sauce 15. 1 tsp Dijon mustard 16. 1 tbsp chopped parsley Recipe 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne until al dente. Drain and set aside. 2. Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. 3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and slice. 4. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Stir in the honey, soy sauce, Dijon mustard, and chicken broth. Simmer for 2 minutes. 6. Add the heavy cream and cook over medium heat until slightly thickened. 7. Stir in the Parmesan cheese until smooth and creamy. 8. Toss the cooked penne into the sauce, coating every piece evenly. 9. Return the sliced chicken to the skillet and spoon some sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 2 minutes to blend the flavors. 11. Garnish with chopped parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. 12. Serve hot with garlic bread or a fresh salad. Follow for more delicious and easy recipes!

Chicken, Rice & Feta Bake 🍅🍗🧀 One baking dish, 6 meals, and almost 50g of protein per serving. Meal prep doesn’t need to be complicated. Macros (per serving – makes 6) Calories – 491 Protein – 51g Carbs – 32g Fat – 17g Ingredients 🥣  2 lbs or ~900g Chicken Breast, Raw 600g or ~4 cups Cherry Tomatoes 8 oz or 227g Block Feta Cheese 1 medium Red Onion, diced 1 cup or ~165g Corn 5 cloves Garlic, roughly chopped 2 tbsp or 30ml Olive Oil 400g Cooked Jasmine Rice or ~135g / 3/4 cup Dry Jasmine Rice 3 tbsp Grated Parmesan-Romano Fresh Basil for Topping  Seasonings to taste  Salt Black Pepper Paprika Oregano How to make 🧑‍🍳  1️⃣ Add the cherry tomatoes, diced onion, corn, garlic, and chicken breasts to a large baking dish. Place the block of feta in the center, drizzle everything with olive oil, then season with salt, pepper, paprika, and oregano. 2️⃣ Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 35–40 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and reaches 165°F (75°C) internally. 3️⃣ While everything is baking, cook your jasmine rice according to the package directions. 4️⃣ Remove the baking dish from the oven. Shred the chicken, then mash the feta and tomatoes and mix everything together until you have a creamy sauce. 5️⃣ Add 400g of your cooked rice and mix until the rice and chicken are completely coated in the feta and tomato sauce. 6️⃣ Top with grated Parmesan and fresh basil, then place back in the oven for another 10 minutes. 7️⃣ Take it out, let it cool for a few minutes, portion into 6 servings, and enjoy! Creamy, cheesy, loaded with chicken, and you’ve got 6 high-protein meals ready to go. Doesn’t get much easier than that. 🔥 Drop a like and follow for more high protein, macro friendly recipes.
